```{r, init_chunk, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
createdDate <- gsub(" 0", " ",format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y"))
idPath <- "../../"

library('RODBC')
library('DBI')
library('RSQLite')
library('tidyverse')
library('lubridate')
library('DT')

library('scales')

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
options("scipen"=100)

ticker <- params$ticker
fName <- params$fName

#source("/mnt/hollandC/StockViz/R/config.r")
#equitySummDb <- "/mnt/data/recoll/EQUITY.db"

source("/mnt/hollandr/config.r")
equitySummDb <- "/srv/stockviz-dashboard/EQUITY.db"

bucketUrl <- "https://etf-us-risk-plots.stockviz.biz/"

lcon <- odbcDriverConnect(sprintf("Driver={ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server};Server=%s;Database=%s;Uid=%s;Pwd=%s;", ldbserver, ldbname, ldbuser, ldbpassword), case = "nochange", believeNRows = TRUE)

tickerName <- sqlQuery(lcon, sprintf("select top 1 NAME from EQUITY_TICKER where symbol='%s'", ticker))[[1]]
industryDf <- sqlQuery(lcon, sprintf("select basic_industry 
                                   from nse_industry a 
                                   where a.symbol = '%s' 
                                   and a.time_stamp = (select max(b.time_stamp) 
                                         from nse_industry b 
                                         where b.symbol = a.symbol)", ticker))

if(nrow(industryDf) > 0){
  industry <- industryDf[[1]]
  indusLink <- paste0('/reports01/index/industry/rp-', gsub("[^[:alnum:] ]| ", "", industry), '.html')
  indusLinkTxt <- sprintf("[%s](%s)", industry, indusLink)
} else {
  indusLinkTxt <- ""
}
fanPlotName <- paste0(bucketUrl, fName, ".fan.png")
cumPlotName <- paste0(bucketUrl, fName, ".cumret.png")
annPlotName <- paste0(bucketUrl, fName, ".annret.png")

smaCumPlotName <- NULL
if(file.exists(sprintf("plots/%s.sma.cumret.png", fName))){
  smaCumPlotName <- paste0(bucketUrl, fName, ".sma.cumret.png")
}

epsFileName <- NULL
if(file.exists(sprintf("plots/%s.eps.png", fName))){
  epsFileName <- paste0(bucketUrl, fName, ".eps.png")
}

revenueFileName <- NULL
if(file.exists(sprintf("plots/%s.RevenueFromOperations.png", fName))){
  revenueFileName <- paste0(bucketUrl, fName, ".RevenueFromOperations.png")
}

ebitFileName <- NULL
if(file.exists(sprintf("plots/%s.ebit.png", fName))){
  ebitFileName <- paste0(bucketUrl, fName, ".ebit.png")
}

metric1FileName <- NULL
if(file.exists(sprintf("plots/%s.metric-1.png", fName))){
  metric1FileName <- paste0(bucketUrl, fName, ".metric-1.png")
}
metric2FileName <- NULL
if(file.exists(sprintf("plots/%s.metric-2.png", fName))){
  metric2FileName <- paste0(bucketUrl, fName, ".metric-2.png")
}
bvFileName <- NULL
if(file.exists(sprintf("plots/%s.book-value.png", fName))){
  bvFileName <- paste0(bucketUrl, fName, ".book-value.png")
}

ownershipFileName <- NULL
if(file.exists(sprintf("plots/%s.ownership.png", fName))){
  ownershipFileName <- paste0(bucketUrl, fName, ".ownership.png")
}

mtfFileName <- NULL
if(file.exists(sprintf("plots/%s.mtf.png", fName))){
  mtfFileName <- paste0(bucketUrl, fName, ".mtf.png")
}

aiSummaries <- NULL
mydb <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), dbname = equitySummDb, flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
aiAsOf <- dbGetQuery(mydb, "select max(as_of) from EQUITY_SUMMARY where SYMBOL = $1", params=list(ticker))
if(nrow(aiAsOf) > 0 && !is.na(aiAsOf[[1]])){
  aiSummaries <- dbGetQuery(mydb, "SELECT * FROM EQUITY_SUMMARY WHERE SYMBOL = $1 and AS_OF = $2", params=list(ticker, aiAsOf[[1]]))
}
dbDisconnect(mydb)

brokerTimeline <- NULL
narrative <- NULL
brokerDb <- "/srv/data/doc_meta.db"
if(file.exists(brokerDb)){
  bdb <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), dbname = brokerDb, flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
  brokerTimeline <- dbGetQuery(bdb, "
    SELECT AUTO_ID, REPORT_DATE, RECOMMENDATION, PREDICTED_RETURN, ACTUAL_RETURN, TARGET_DATE, OUTCOME
    FROM RR_TIMELINE
    WHERE SYMBOL = $1
      AND REPORT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND REPORT_DATE != ''
      AND RECOMMENDATION IS NOT NULL AND RECOMMENDATION != ''
    ORDER BY REPORT_DATE DESC", params = list(ticker))
  if(dbExistsTable(bdb, "RR_NARRATIVE")){
    narrative <- dbGetQuery(bdb, "SELECT NARRATIVE FROM RR_NARRATIVE WHERE SYMBOL = $1", params = list(ticker))
  }
  dbDisconnect(bdb)
}

brokerAuthors <- sqlQuery(lcon, sprintf("SELECT AUTO_ID, AUTHOR FROM BROKER_REPORT WHERE SYMBOL = '%s'", ticker))
if(!is.data.frame(brokerAuthors) || nrow(brokerAuthors) == 0){
  brokerAuthors <- NULL
}
```

```{r, ai_summary_chunk, echo = FALSE, results='asis', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.height=12, fig.width=12}

if(!is.null(aiSummaries) && nrow(aiSummaries) > 0 && !is.na(aiSummaries$SUMMARY[1]) && !is.null(aiSummaries$SUMMARY[1])){
  cat("## AI Summary", "\n\n")
  cat("*asof: ", aiAsOf[[1]], " *", "\n\n")
  summ <- paste0(unlist(aiSummaries$SUMMARY[1]), collapse = "")
  summ <- str_replace_all(summ, "#### ", "###### ")
  summ <- str_replace_all(summ, "### ", "##### ")
  summ <- str_replace_all(summ, "## ", "#### ")
  summ <- str_replace_all(summ, "# ", "### ")
  
  cat(summ, "\n\n")
}
```

```{r, broker_narrative_chunk, echo = FALSE, results='asis', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

n <- NULL
if(!is.null(narrative) && nrow(narrative) > 0 && !is.na(narrative$NARRATIVE[1]) && nzchar(trimws(narrative$NARRATIVE[1]))){
  n <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(narrative$NARRATIVE[1]), error = function(e) NULL)
}

arc <- character()
fears <- character()
optimism <- character()
if(!is.null(n)){
  if(!is.null(n$arc)){
    arc <- as.character(n$arc)
    arc <- arc[!is.na(arc) & nzchar(trimws(arc))]
  }
  if(!is.null(n$fears_came_true)){
    fears <- as.character(n$fears_came_true)
    fears <- fears[!is.na(fears) & nzchar(trimws(fears))]
  }
  if(!is.null(n$optimism_failed)){
    optimism <- as.character(n$optimism_failed)
    optimism <- optimism[!is.na(optimism) & nzchar(trimws(optimism))]
  }
}

if(length(arc) > 0 || length(fears) > 0 || length(optimism) > 0){
  cat("## Broker Narrative", "\n\n")
  if(length(arc) > 0){
    cat(arc[1], "\n\n")
  }
  if(length(fears) > 0){
    cat("**Fears that came true**", "\n\n")
    cat(paste0("- ", fears, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
  }
  if(length(optimism) > 0){
    cat("**Optimism that failed**", "\n\n")
    cat(paste0("- ", optimism, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r, broker_timeline_chunk, echo = FALSE, results='asis', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.height=12, fig.width=12}

if(!is.null(brokerTimeline) && nrow(brokerTimeline) > 0){

  normRec <- function(x) {
    x <- trimws(x)
    up <- toupper(x)
    dplyr::case_when(
      up == "BUY" ~ "Buy",
      up == "ACCUMULATE" ~ "Accumulate",
      up == "ADD" ~ "Add",
      up == "SELL" ~ "Sell",
      up == "REDUCE" ~ "Reduce",
      up == "HOLD" ~ "Hold",
      up == "OVERWEIGHT" ~ "Overweight",
      up == "UNDERWEIGHT" ~ "Underweight",
      up %in% c("EQUALWEIGHT", "EQUAL-WEIGHT") ~ "Equal-weight",
      up %in% c("NEUTRAL", "NE") ~ "Neutral",
      up == "POSITIVE" ~ "Positive",
      up %in% c("NOT RATED", "NR", "UNRATED", "NON-RATED") ~ "Not Rated",
      up == "DROPPING COVERAGE" ~ "Dropping Coverage",
      up == "EXIT" ~ "Exit",
      up == "SUBSCRIBE" ~ "Subscribe",
      up == "UNDER REVIEW" ~ "Under Review",
      TRUE ~ stringr::str_to_title(x)
    )
  }

  fmtD <- function(x) {
    x[x == ""] <- NA
    d <- as.Date(x)
    out <- format(d, "%Y-%m-%d")
    out[is.na(d)] <- NA
    out
  }

  rngTxt <- fmtD(range(brokerTimeline$REPORT_DATE))

  brokerTimeline$AUTO_ID <- as.numeric(brokerTimeline$AUTO_ID)
  if(!is.null(brokerAuthors)){
    brokerAuthors$AUTO_ID <- as.numeric(brokerAuthors$AUTO_ID)
    tl0 <- brokerTimeline |> left_join(brokerAuthors, by = "AUTO_ID")
  } else {
    tl0 <- brokerTimeline |> mutate(AUTHOR = NA_character_)
  }

  tl <- tl0 |>
    mutate(
      REPORT_DATE = fmtD(REPORT_DATE),
      TARGET_DATE = fmtD(TARGET_DATE),
      REC = normRec(RECOMMENDATION),
      BROKER = ifelse(is.na(AUTHOR) | AUTHOR == "", "\u2014", AUTHOR),
      PRED = PREDICTED_RETURN,
      ACT = ACTUAL_RETURN,
      OUTCOME = ifelse(is.na(OUTCOME) | OUTCOME == "", "NA", OUTCOME)
    ) |>
    select(REPORT_DATE, BROKER, REC, PRED, ACT, OUTCOME, TARGET_DATE)

  tl$TARGET_DATE[is.na(tl$TARGET_DATE)] <- ""

  tlDt <- datatable(
    tl, rownames = FALSE,
    colnames = c("Report Date", "Broker", "Call", "Predicted", "Actual", "Outcome", "Target Date"),
    class = 'cell-border stripe',
    filter = 'none',
    options = list(pageLength = nrow(tl), dom = 't', order = list(list(0, 'desc')))
  ) |>
    formatPercentage(c('PRED', 'ACT'), digits = 1) |>
    formatStyle('PRED', color = styleInterval(c(-0.001, 0.001), c('#8B0000', '#777777', '#006400'))) |>
    formatStyle('ACT',  color = styleInterval(c(-0.001, 0.001), c('#8B0000', '#777777', '#006400'))) |>
    formatStyle('OUTCOME',
      color = styleEqual(c('SUCCESS','DISAPPOINTMENT','NEUTRAL','FLAT','PENDING','NA'),
                         c('#006400','#8B0000','#555555','#777777','#b8860b','#999999')),
      fontWeight = 'bold')

  cat("## Broker Timeline", "\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("*%d broker calls · %s to %s*\n\n", nrow(tl), rngTxt[1], rngTxt[2]))

  htmltools::tagList(tlDt)
}
```
